An R followed by k L letters acts on a vertical state as scalar -5/3 mod 2^k, generating all units 1+8Z/2^k. This yields every allowed affine pair at every level. Each admissible pair has exactly two labeled incoming transitions, uniform stationarity; reachability from v0 plus L(v0)=v0 give irreducibility and aperiodicity. Binary prefix-block decomposition turns dyadic distribution into full natural densities. Independently recomputed full reachable modular graph and coset equality for k=1,...,7; these finite checks corroborate rather than replace infinite proof.
